mode: synthetic isolated React renderer under StrictMode; external network blocked; no real accounts, phone or server writes
checks: initial scope does not issue an empty search or assign actions to unknown entities
explicit submission trims only the query and fixes the current topic
page two sends exact first and last cursors and accumulates without duplicate feeds
five reference sorts reset pagination and retain the topic and exact query
ten reference types reset pagination without broadening topic scope
page-two network retry preserves page one and repeats the exact failed cursor
page-two verification retries the same request and accumulates the original first page
initial failure is an error rather than an empty result and retries page one
an actual empty success is distinct from failure and cannot paginate
clear cancels a delayed search and does not restore its result
a newer query wins over a delayed old response
same-query account switch commits its new scope before the old result is released
changing the topic resets the form and ignores an old same-query response
late verification after clear cannot repeat an obsolete request
late verification after account switch cannot replay with the new identity
unmount disposes delayed reads and remount starts with no active search
narrow dark view keeps controls and result text within the window
